assessment: The candidate satisfies the four supplied LRT acceptance criteria for the scoped loopback test controls.

evidence: src/domain/config.ts defaults localTestMode to false and rejects enabled mode for hosts outside 127.0.0.1, ::1, and localhost, or when Alpaca/OpenRouter credentials are present.
src/api/app.ts registers /__local routes only when localTestMode is enabled and a harness is supplied; createApp rejects enabled mode without the harness.
tests/config.test.ts covers default-off and invalid bind/credential cases; tests/local-test-harness.test.ts confirms the state route is 404 by default.
verification/control-plane/tasks/phase2-loopback-test-controls/checks/health-tests.json records PASS, exit_code 0. The verifier lane also records criterion-level PASS.
src/infra/local-fixtures.ts loads checked-in fixtures from fixed module-relative paths.

src/domain/local-test-harness.ts reset() restores fixture start time and replay state; setClock() controls virtual time; advance() rejects values outside 1..100 and advances only available fixture events.
The harness has no provider, database, or network dependency; provider responses are assembled from fixture data.

tests/local-test-harness.test.ts covers reset, virtual time, replay bounds, and simulated failure/recovery. verification/control-plane/tasks/phase2-loopback-test-controls/checks/health-runtime.json records PASS, exit_code 0.
src/domain/local-test-harness.ts state() returns replay market snapshot, normalized account snapshot, and replay cursor/total.
src/domain/account-state.ts normalization supplies positions, open orders, and exposure; the local test asserts these fields.
The health-runtime structured check records PASS, exit_code 0; verifier evidence independently maps the implementation and test coverage to this criterion.
src/api/app.ts records request method, Fastify route template, response status, and harness virtual timestamp through the response hook; it does not pass URL query or body into record().
src/domain/local-test-harness.ts bounds trace retention at 200 and pages at 100 records. Trace records contain no query or body fields.

tests/local-test-harness.test.ts checks query-sentinel exclusion, route query exclusion, and virtual-time records. verification/control-plane/tasks/phase2-loopback-test-controls/checks/health-runtime.json records PASS, exit_code 0.

Reports typecheck and full test suite success with criterion-level evidence.

limitations: This evaluation covers only LRT-01..LRT-04 for the loopback test-control slice. It does not fulfill the broader user objective or all Phase 2 requirements in goals/phase-02-alpaca-data-account-state.md.

The Phase 2 goal includes production Alpaca PAPER data/account integration, stream ownership and limits, robust stream/reconciliation behavior, downstream use of normalized state, operational observability, and verification at the highest authorized Alpaca rung. This candidate does not establish those requirements.
The scoped checks demonstrate offline local controls; they do not establish credential-backed Alpaca connectivity or a complete decision-to-risk-governor-to-order lifecycle.
